blocks.text: Note:
In the treatment of epilepsy-related depression, priority should be given to optimizing seizure control, since improved psychosocial functioning tends to accompany seizure remission

runs.text: improved psychosocial functioning tends to accompany seizure remission

blocks.text: Some anticonvulsant therapies, including sodium valproate, gabapentin, carbamazepine, and lamotrigine, also have antidepressant effects and may prove effective in treating depression in patients with epilepsy.

runs.text: have antidepressant effects and may prove effective in treating depression in patients with epilepsy.

blocks.text: Phenobarbitone is known to produce depression.
